shortDescription: Australia’s banking regulator has imposed additional capital requirements on ING Bank Australia Ltd. after the lender said it misreported its liquidity position over several years, according to Bloomberg.The move follows the bank’s disclosure of the reporting failings.

title: Australia Regulator Orders ING Bank Australia to Hold More Capital
